style: A keyframe from a polished modern Japanese TV anime opening sequence: clean confident ink line art, flat cel colours with one crisp shadow tone and soft highlights, glossy anime eyes, vivid saturated colours, dynamic low-angle composition, dramatic rim light, speed-line energy, cinematic 16:9 framing with the character large in frame from the waist up. The character is an anime version of the person in the attached photo: keep the face shape, hairstyle, hair colour, glasses (if any) and skin tone true to the photo so friends recognise them at a glance, pretty and flattering, never goofy. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no speech bubbles, no frame border.
motion: Anime opening sequence shot, smooth expressive 2D anime animation, the character keeps the same face and outfit, no text appears, no new people appear, energetic but clear motion, one continuous shot.

cast.name: Yichen Lin
cast.scene: He is a stage magician in a black shirt with a top hat, standing in front of swinging red velvet curtains, fanning a perfect hand of playing cards toward the viewer with a confident smirk, golden sparkles around his fingers.
cast.move: He flicks his wrist and the fanned cards fly out in a spinning arc around him and snap back into his hand as a neat deck; the red curtains sway; he tips his top hat with a smirk.

cast.name: Chang Chen
cast.scene: She wears round glasses and holds a coffee cup in a golden armoured gauntlet glove with six glowing coloured gems on the knuckles, two exam papers with big red check marks floating behind her, coffee beans in the air.
cast.move: The six gems on her golden glove light up one by one, she snaps her fingers and coffee beans and exam papers burst into the air around her in slow motion; she sips the coffee calmly.

cast.name: Haotian Shen
cast.scene: He wears a winged silver helmet and a red cape over his patterned shirt, holding a big rune hammer up high, a thunderstorm swirling behind him with lightning.
cast.move: He raises the hammer and lightning strikes it, his red cape billows in the storm wind, he grins and points the hammer at the viewer.

cast.name: Jixuan Ruan
cast.scene: She holds a large calligraphy brush in front of a round fan of warm paper with an ink orchid painting and a swallow; ink splashes float around her like ribbons.
cast.move: She sweeps the brush through the air and a ribbon of black ink trails behind it and turns into a flying swallow; ink drops float and swirl around her; she smiles.

cast.name: Keyi Yin
cast.scene: He sits on an esports arena stage under sweeping coloured spotlights holding a game controller, a gold trophy beside him, confetti in the air, an LED wall glowing behind him.
cast.move: He mashes the controller buttons at lightning speed, then throws both arms up in victory as gold confetti rains down and the spotlights sweep across the arena.

cast.name: Ohm Venkatachalam
cast.scene: He stands on a giant glowing silicon chip with gold circuit traces, tall memory-chip towers rising around him, streams of light packets racing along the traces.
cast.move: Glowing data packets race along the gold circuit traces around him and up the memory towers, the chip lights up beneath his feet, he crosses his arms and nods proudly.

cast.name: Parikshit
cast.scene: He is a mountaineer in a teal jacket wearing a glowing headlamp on a snowy Himalayan ridge at night under a sky full of stars, a moonlit peak behind him.
cast.move: He clicks on his headlamp and its beam sweeps across the snow, a line of headlamps lights up behind him on the switchbacks, he plants his trekking pole and looks up at the moonlit summit.

cast.name: Rishabh
cast.scene: He wears a dark blazer and glasses, standing inside a glowing GPU core made of neon grids, glowing data tiles flying along a cyan rail arcing over his head, his glasses reflecting scrolling code.
cast.move: Warp-speed light streaks blast past him, glowing data tiles zip along the cyan rail over his head into a golden cube that crunches them, his glasses flash; he smiles confidently.

cast.name: Xiang Fang
cast.scene: He sings into a handheld microphone on a concert stage with laser beams and spotlights, a crowd of glow sticks in front of him.
cast.move: He sings into the microphone and throws his free hand up, laser beams sweep the stage and the crowd waves glow sticks; he spins once and points at the viewer.

cast.name: Xinwei Qiang
cast.scene: He wears a chef's apron in a black and gold studio kitchen, tossing food in a steel pan that bursts into a big flambe flame.
cast.move: He tosses the food high out of the steel pan, a big burst of flambe fire lights his face, he catches the food in the pan and plates it with a flourish.

cast.name: Yue Guan
cast.scene: He holds a wooden baseball bat in a night ballpark under stadium lights, red speed rays behind him, his glasses flashing with determination.
cast.move: The pitch streaks in, he swings the bat with full force, a huge impact flash, the ball rockets into the night sky over the stadium lights; he watches it fly with a grin.

cast.name: Zaifeng Pan
cast.scene: He wears a graduation mortarboard cap and holds a tall stack of research papers in each hand, papers flying out like confetti, stars bursting behind him.
cast.move: The two stacks of papers in his hands fire off sheets in rapid volleys like a machine, papers swirl around him in a storm, he laughs.

cast.name: Zhengding Hu
cast.scene: He wears aviator sunglasses and a peaked general's cap with medals on his jacket, standing in front of the Golden Gate Bridge under bright sun rays.
cast.move: Golden sun rays sweep across the sky, he lowers his aviator sunglasses with one finger, looks at the viewer and gives a confident salute.

cast.name: Zhongkai Yu
cast.scene: He wears a graduation mortarboard cap and a gold medal on a ribbon around his neck, standing between two golden cliffs at sunset, a gold trophy shining.
cast.move: A gold medal swings onto his chest and catches the sunset light with a sparkle, he holds up a golden trophy and the sunset flares behind him.

cast.name: Zhuo Chen
cast.scene: He wears a gold medal on a red ribbon and points to the sky; a small storm cloud floats over his raised hand and rains, a spinning atom glows beside his head.
cast.move: He turns his raised hand over and a storm cloud rises out of it and rains down, the atom beside him spins, his gold medal swings and glints.

cast.name: Jiarui Luan
cast.scene: She wears a blue Fair Isle knit cardigan and a matching knit hat with a pompom inside a giant snow globe with the CN Tower and a Toronto night skyline behind her, snowflakes piling up into a perfect bell-curve shaped snow drift beside her.
cast.move: Snow swirls inside the globe and settles into a perfect bell-curve shaped drift beside her, the CN Tower beacon blinks, she catches a snowflake on her mitten and smiles.

cast.name: Prof. Yufei Ding
cast.scene: She wears a navy blazer over a black-and-white chevron striped top and red-rimmed half-rim glasses, standing on a San Diego beach at sunset beside a palm tree, a fluffy white cat sitting on her shoulder.
cast.move: The sun sets over the Pacific behind her, palm fronds sway, her white cat on her shoulder flicks its tail and blinks; she smiles warmly and gives a small wave.
